notes: Notion page 27 protocol. Change only by creating a new version; never tune on test seeds.
success: survive all episode_steps steps with final health >= 0.5

protocol.train: learn online on train seeds under the swap regime, then freeze the checkpoint
protocol.evaluate: frozen weights (non-parametric state such as context belief, affect and memory may update) on test seeds; same regime schedule for every agent
protocol.pilot: 2 seeds smoke, 5 validation seeds pilot, then all 20 test seeds once the config is frozen

metrics.recovery: episodes after a rule flip until the rolling-5 success rate returns to >= 90% of the 10 pre-flip episodes, capped at 20 (censored)
metrics.poison_p10: mean poison eaten in the first 10 episodes after a flip
metrics.retention: success on a previously mastered regime after learning a new one

pass_rule.ci: paired bootstrap 95% CI over test seeds excludes zero

baselines.B2: v0 frozen: affect + memory + JEPA world model + System 1/2 gate
baselines.v0.1: B2 + BOCPD context belief + arousal-gated plasticity + salience x20 (promising single-seed results 2026-10-10, to be confirmed here)
